messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: error import data from SPSS to R
parts:
I check my data in SPSS and i have integers numbers and dont' have missings....  But... when i import my data to R reports a different number, for example decimal numbers.  I don't know if that " error" is a bug or If I'am doing something wrong with R or SPSS.

SPSS does not have a special "integer" type, just "Scale" (i.e., floating-point numbers -- in R this is equivalent to the "numeric" class).  If you only see integers in the SPSS Data Viewer, then that is just the choice for the display.  You can change the number of displayed decimal points in Variable View to check whether there are non-integer numbers in the SPSS data that need to be corrected. 

In R, if you need a variable to be "integer" rather than floating-point "numeric", you can change it:

myData$myVariable <- as.integer(myData$myVariable)

But that will just drop any decimal values (i.e., round down).  So you should correct those values in R or SPSS if they need to be corrected.

Terry
